title: Named-root status and release: add route-level tests and a SQLite read-back test for the release fence
outcome: The status and release API is covered end to end. Request-level tests through the app router cover GET /api/engram/named-roots and POST /api/engram/named-roots/release: wiring, the camelCase JSON shape, 422 on unknown fields, and the ApiError status mapping. A test persists the metadata and then confirms the EngramNamedRootRelease fence through its is_already_durable read-back branch.
acceptance: One request-level router test per route asserts the response shape, the 422 for an unknown field, and at least one refusal status (409 for a live claim)

A test confirms an EngramNamedRootRelease fence by read-back from the persisted metadata row, not from the in-memory delta, for both a committed release (passes) and a still-retained selection (does not)
